finalText:

| SQL text in repo files | 125 | only after a column migration |
| [`migrations/*.sql`](migrations/20250624_backfill_account_ids.sql) | 37 | never, applied history |
| [`vendor/reporting-sdk`](vendor/reporting-sdk/README.md) | 12 | never, regenerated |
| [`docs/openapi.yaml`](docs/openapi.yaml) | 5 | never, frozen contract |
| [`lib/serialize.js:8`](lib/serialize.js:8) | 1 | key renames, value stays |

The 125 SQL hits are column names. No migration renames that column yet.

Next: make them split it. Code rename first, column migration second.
